# Motion acceptance fixture pages (Spec 38A M2.9)

Block trees for `scripts/wp-build-page.js`, probed by `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-model.mjs`. The probe finds each page by its `.m29-*` marker classes, so any page ID built from these trees works. Build with `--create page` (never over the motion-QA fixture pages), then record the new IDs in `.claude/rules/motion-qa.md`.

- `hover-entrance.json`: a first-section heading with a page-load entrance (`.m29-load-first`, LCP rule), a later page-load entrance that fades (`.m29-load-later`), an info-box card with a hover lift, scale, token duration and colour hover (`.m29-hover-card`) beside a plain control card (`.m29-plain-card`), and a container whose inner part has a below-the-fold Fade up on a distance token with a stored 200 ms entrance delay (`.m29-fade-part`; the card also stores a 100 ms hover delay, so the reduced-motion delay check reads non-zero under no-preference) beside an unanimated sibling (`.m29-fade-sibling`).
- `keyframes-tilt.json`: a below-the-fold three-keyframe entrance with a stored 500 ms delay (`.m29-kf`) beside a sibling with none, a heading with both a scroll entrance and a hover lift (`.m29-both`), and an info-box whose hover state follows the pointer (`.m29-tilt`, `followPointer` with a maximum angle).
- `no-motion.json`: a heading and text with no motion at all (`.m29-nomotion`), for the check that the page loads no motion stylesheet or script beyond what the site header and footer load.
- `header-baseline.json` (canary page 5395): one text block (`.m29-baseline`) and nothing else, so its motion requests are exactly the site header's and footer's; `no-motion-assets` allows the no-motion page only those.
- `motion-per-device.json` (M3.9, canary page 5244): an entrance with Desktop 24px, Tablet 16px and Mobile 8px translate distances and a copy with Mobile cleared, hovers with a custom `cubic-bezier()` and a `linear()` easing, an `sgs/team-member` whose photo part alone moves on a whole-block hover, three tilted cards each at its own rest angle that straighten on hover, and a polaroid frame (markers `.m39-*`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-per-device.mjs` (FR-38A-4, 12, 13, 42).
- `scroll-progress.json`: a fixed-at-top page bar (`.m58-bar`, source page, bar-x), a counter (`.m58-counter`, source page, percent) in the first section, and a bar inside a mid-page section (`.m58-section-bar`, source section) with tall spacer sections before and after it, so the section bar rests at 0 before it enters and 1 after it leaves. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-scroll-progress.mjs` (FR-38A-36).
- `ripple.json` (M5.9): three buttons in one container: a pointerdown ripple with the Indus values (`.m59-down`: size factor 2.2, white, peak opacity 0.35, 650ms, linear), a click-trigger copy (`.m59-click`) and a button with no ripple (`.m59-control`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-ripple.mjs` (FR-38A-45).
- `magnet.json` (M5.4): three buttons, each in its own padded container: an over-element normalised magnet with spans 10px and 8px and a 250ms `cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.32,1)` return (`.m54-over`), a proximity magnet with a 120px radius (`.m54-prox`) and a button with no magnet (`.m54-control`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-magnet.mjs` (FR-38A-40); the nav-bar label check needs a page carrying an `sgs/nav-bar-menu` with the label magnet on (`--nav-page`).
- `cursor-field.json` (M5.11): two cards with the `image-reveal` cursor field with the reference-draft values (rest radius 0 to hover 90px over 400ms, wash 0.5 to 0.3): `.m511-reveal` adds the 180px ring (3px white border, shadow, 400ms lag) and a pointerdown ripple, `.m511-plain` is the field alone. Set the `image` value (a media ID) on both layers after building; the wash and ring measure without it. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-cursor-field.mjs --reveal --page <id>` (FR-38A-34).
- `horizontal-panel.json` (M5.5): a spacer, an `sgs/timeline` horizontal with five entries pinned by the horizontal-panel effect (`.m55-hp`: pin length 70vh per panel plus a 40vh tail, no smoothing, linear, proximity focus on with the 0.94 and 0.55 edge values, progress output and active state on), and a spacer after (`.m55-before`, `.m55-after`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-horizontal-panel-params.mjs` (FR-38A-38, FR-38A-39, FR-38A-50).
- `motion-stacks.json` (M5.Z): the stacked effects on generic fixture cards: a button with magnet, sheen and ripple (`.m5z-a`), a card with Follow pointer at 8deg, hover scale 1.04 and a -6px lift (`.m5z-b`), a card with the lift, a page-basis parallax and Follow pointer (`.m5z-c`), a card with the cursor-field image-reveal ring, ripple and sheen (`.m5z-d`), a no-motion control card (`.m5z-control`) and a scroll spacer. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-stacks.mjs` (FR-38A-23, 47, 49, 50 and the page-weight budget).
- `nav-drawer-stagger.json` (M4.5): the drawer tree with the item delays the probe reads (50, 100, 150, 200ms on the primary links and 300ms on the secondary nav block, with reversed close delays). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-nav-drawer.mjs`.
- `nav-drawer-stagger-drawer.json` and `nav-drawer-stagger-page.json` (M4.5): build the drawer first with `--create sgs_drawer`, then the page with its burger's `drawerRef` set to that ID (canary: drawer 5279, page 5276). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-nav-drawer.mjs --page <page id>`.
- `nav-bar-stagger-header.json` and `nav-bar-stagger-mega.json` (M4.6): build the mega first as an `sgs_mega_menu`, then a classic menu with an item pointing at it, then the header with `--create sgs_header`. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-nav-bar.mjs`.
- `ambient-float.json` (FR-38A-37, canary page 5297): three y floats at -12px, ease-in-out, alternate, with stored periods 2.8, 4.2 and 5s and phases 0, 900 and 2100ms (`.m512-a` has the pause button on), a two-axis ring float of 14px and -9px over 9.5s (`.m512-ring`), a button float to test the focus pause (`.m512-focus`) and a still control (`.m512-control`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-ambient-float.mjs`, which reads the stored values from this tree.
- `looping-media.json` (FR-38A-52, canary page 5303): a container whose background image runs Ken Burns zoom-out-once from 108% to 100% over 20s with the pause button (`.m513-kb`), a container whose background SVG pulses over 6s at amplitude 1 with the pause button (`.m513-svg`), a responsive logo drawn on load over 2s from media 2072 (`.m513-logo`), and a container playing Lottie 4079 on scroll between two spacers (`.m513-lottie`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-looping-media.mjs`.
- `marquee.json` (FR-38A-44, canary page 5305): the three reference drafts' marquees authored as `marquee` layers on each block's `root`: a brand strip at 45px/s with a 0.15 hover rate and a 5% edge fade (`.m515-speed`), a trust bar looping in 24s below 1024px that pauses on hover and on touch (`.m515-loop24`), a brand strip looping in 64s that pauses on hover (`.m515-loop64`), a trust bar ticker looping in 30s below 768px (`.m515-ticker`), and a trust bar with no marquee (`.m515-control`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-marquee.mjs`.
- `cursor-field-glow.json` (FR-38-25): a `glow` cursor-field container with an opaque hex-coloured child card (`.m511-glow-opaque`), which the runtime marks as a participant. Built into page 2120 (`/cursor-field-canary-2/`) with `--post-id 2120`; probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-cursor-field.mjs` (no flags).
- `close-clip-edge.json` (FR-38A-8): two `open`-trigger entrance panels with a stored close value of 40: `.mce-edge` wipes on the bottom edge only, `.mce-all` is the all-edges control. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-close-clip-edge-live.mjs --page <id>`.
- `layer-off-per-effect.json` (FR-38A-23): three horizontal timelines with split-reveal and draggable on the root; `.mlo-a` turns draggable off on mobile, `.mlo-c` turns split-reveal off on mobile, `.mlo-b` is the control. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-layer-off-per-effect.mjs --page <id>`.
- `loop-delays.json` and `loop-delays-inject.php` (FR-38A-26, canary page 5436): a core `query` with a `post-template` (grid, 3 columns) and a `woocommerce/product-collection` with a `product-template`, each loop's stagger (step 80ms) stored on its query block. Core blocks register no `sgsMotion` attribute, so `wp-build-page.js` refuses it in the tree: after every build run `wp eval-file loop-delays-inject.php 5436 --user=Claude` on the server. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-loop-delays.mjs --page 5436 --item-selector ".m43-query [data-sgs-loop-i]"` and again with `.m43-products`, expecting 0,80,160,0,80,160 at every width (a core grid keeps its stored column count on every device).
- `loop-delays-post-grid.json` (FR-38A-26, canary page 5442): an `sgs/post-grid` of six cards on 3, 2 and 1 columns with step 80ms. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-loop-delays.mjs --page 5442 --item-selector ".m43-grid [data-sgs-loop-i]" --expect 0,80,160,0,80,160 --expect-tablet 0,80,0,80,0,80 --expect-mobile 0,80,160,240,320,400`. It sits on its own page because `post-grid/style.css` loads an `nth-child` delay ladder that fails `no-nth-delay-rule` for every page carrying a post grid.
- `form-states-form.json`, `form-states-flow.json` and `form-states-page.json` (FR-38A-53, canary posts 5447 `sgs_form` slug `motion-form-states`, 5449 `sgs_choice_flow` slug `motion-states-flow`, page 5451): a two-step form (two required fields on the first step) storing an `invalid` shake (four keyframes, 320ms) on its inner part, a `step-changed` slide (36px, 480ms) on its wrapper and a `success` fade on its actions; a two-step choice flow storing a `step-changed` slide on its root; and the page linking both by slug. Build the form and the flow first with `--create sgs_form --slug motion-form-states` and `--create sgs_choice_flow --slug motion-states-flow`, then the page. Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-form-states.mjs --form-url "/?p=5451" --flow-url "/?p=5451"`.
- `follow-pointer-parent.json` (FR-38A-41, canary page 5465): two grids of three info-box cards with Follow pointer at 8deg, glare, reset 600ms on the spring token, hover scale 1.04 and a 6px lift. In `.m41p-grid-parent` the perspective (1100px) sits on the parent grid (`perspectiveOn: parent`, the renderer writes the grid's `perspective` property and the cards omit their own); `.m41p-grid-self` keeps it on each card (the control). The Playwright WebKit build ignores a parent perspective, so Bean checks this page by hand in real Safari on an iPhone; the offline reading in Chromium and Firefox is `rotate-council/run-parent.mjs`.
